'''Chalmer Trillili''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Trillili served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] for a [[Time/Legends|time]], but he eventually deserted and founded [[The Scourge]], a small [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group that operated in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. Trillili [[Captain/Legends|captained]] the ''[[Impasse]]'', a [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] [[Super Transport VII]] container ship that The Scourge equipped with a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]], and he also owned the modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Personal Profit]]''. Trillili's activities gained the attention of the [[Khuiumin Survivors]], another pirate group, and the Suvivors sent Trillili a communiqué, offering to let him join their organization. Around this time, The Scourge captured the [[Gray Griffins]], a Rebel Alliance [[Scout/Legends|scout]] team, and the pirates attempted to extract a ransom for the team. However, a group of Alliance agents traveled to the Scourge's base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dega]] to rescue the Griffins. Trillili went into hiding in his personal quarters and there, the agents confronted him and engaged the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] leader in combat.
